rolesTabHint: Manage workspace-wide roles in the Roles tab.
directAndInherited: Assigned directly and also inherited from the customer.
notAssignable: Contains permissions that only apply workspace-wide. Update the role in the role dialog.
emptyDescription: Search for a customer to assign a role to the whole customer or to one project.
noResultsDescription: There are no results for “{search}”. Existing assignments remain visible above.
searchError: Customer search could not be loaded. Try again.
projectsError: Projects for {customer} could not be loaded.
reloadError: The current state could not be loaded after the conflict. Reload it before changing more access.
previewEmpty: No active permissions apply to this selection.
previewPrompt: Choose a customer or project to see the effective permissions.

errors.MEMBER_NOT_FOUND: This member no longer exists. Reload the page.
errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: The assignment is incomplete. Reload the page and try again.
errors.MEMBER_WITHOUT_ROLE: The member needs at least one role. Assign a workspace-wide role in the Roles tab or deactivate the member.
errors.ACCESS_SCOPE_ALREADY_GRANTED: This role is already assigned to this scope.
errors.ACCESS_SCOPE_NOT_ASSIGNABLE: This role cannot be assigned to customers or projects. Update it in the role dialog first.
errors.ACCESS_SCOPE_PROJECT_CUSTOMER_MISMATCH: This project does not belong to the customer. Reload the projects.
errors.ACCESS_SCOPE_NOT_FOUND: This assignment no longer exists. The current state has been reloaded.
errors.INTERNAL: That did not work. Try again.

conflict: Someone just changed access. The current state was adopted; your other selections are preserved.
